{"consolidated_memory":"SILENT DROP ISSUE IN notifications/push/dispatch.py — TWO INCIDENTS

**Incident 1: [2026-02-21] — Serialiser dropping unknown fields**
- Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py (notifications side)
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Repro scenario: dispatch to device token that was rotated
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Signal: send that reports success with no delivery
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 71 GB of blob storage
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR: #2222 on branch fix/silent-drop-1

**Incident 2: [2026-05-12] — Connection pool exhaustion under burst load**
- Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py (notifications side)
- Trigger: clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Repro scenario: dispatch to device token that was rotated
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Signal: send that reports success with no delivery
- Measured outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 88 days running
- Fix: raised pool ceiling and put bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #4184 on branch fix/silent-drop-3

Both incidents occurred in the same area of notifications/push/dispatch.py, with context carried over between investigations. Same symptom (silent drop with delivery failure despite success report), different root causes requiring separate fixes."}
